description: Defines classes and structures for QUIC crypto client configuration, including resumption state, session cache interface, and client crypto configuration with methods for handling handshake messages, server configs, and cached states.

classes.name: QuicResumptionState
classes.description: Stores state information for QUIC connection resumption, including TLS session, transport parameters, application state, and token.

classes.name: SessionCache
classes.description: Interface for managing storage and retrieval of QuicResumptionState objects.

classes.name: QuicCryptoClientConfig
classes.description: Holds crypto configuration for QUIC client, including methods for handshake message processing, server config management, and cached state handling.

classes.name: QuicCryptoClientConfig::CachedState
classes.description: Contains cached information needed for 0-RTT handshake, server config validation, proof validation, and related metadata.

classes.name: QuicCryptoClientConfig::ServerIdFilter
classes.description: Abstract class for filtering server IDs for partial cache deletion.

methods.name: LookupOrCreate
methods.description: Returns a cached state for a given server ID, creating it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: ClearCachedStates
methods.description: Removes cached states matching a filter.

methods.name: FillInchoateClientHello
methods.description: Constructs a client hello message to elicit server info, optionally using cached data.

methods.name: FillClientHello
methods.description: Constructs a client hello message based on current configuration and cached state.

methods.name: ProcessRejection
methods.description: Processes a server rejection message and updates cached info.

methods.name: ProcessServerHello
methods.description: Processes server hello message, updates cache, and outputs negotiated parameters.

methods.name: ProcessServerConfigUpdate
methods.description: Processes server config update message, updating cached source address token and server config.
